attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as DNS resolver for the shared 10.100.223.0/24 network: it answers authoritatively for inventory.internal with node2's address (10.100.223.11) and forwards all other queries to upstream resolvers (1.1.1.1, 9.9.9.9). node2 and node3 (Alpine) were pointed to node1 (10.100.223.10) as their resolver via a persistent dhcpcd static override, verified to survive DHCP renewal/restart. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and post-restart recovery of DNS functionality/config on each.
